pad_tensor_to_multiple: pad a PyTorch tensor to a specified multiple along a given dimension
pad_wav2vec_features: pad wav2vec feature tensors to a multiple of 2 for model compatibility
pad_audio_sequence: pad an audio sequence tensor to a multiple of 4 along the time dimension
pad_with_custom_value: pad a tensor to a multiple using a custom padding value instead of zero
pad_tensor_specific_dim: pad a tensor to a multiple along a specific dimension other than the last
